CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content organization is asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (red cells) is identified, an organizational description is given, and a separate origin/status entry distinguishes representation status for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content sets labeled 'red' and 'blue' with coordinates (attributes: color/positions) for current entries.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are presented separately from the identified content coordinates, distinguishing content identity from representation/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how the grid is organized and gives positional listings for the content, describing presentation/organization.
